summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption price for its entire $350 million outstanding 5.150% notes due 2027 (CUSIP 83192PAC2). The notes will be redeemed October 5, 2026 at 100.245% of par, or $1,002.45 per $1,000 principal, plus $2.15 accrued interest, for a total payment of $1,004.60 per $1,000. The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch, serves as trustee under the October 14, 2020 indenture. This is a routine debt refinancing notice, not a special situation; watch for any concurrent replacement financing.
